findings.claim: ADR 0026 said apm install runs kmctl by tag and fills the uvx cache

verdict.text: The one finding sent back, f1, is fixed.
The ADR's Consequences bullet now names only `just install`, and the starter justfile confirms that recipe runs `kmctl plugin patch` through `uvx --from git+...@kmctl_ref`.
Nothing else in the tree moved, and the stamp I re-ran is green.
Read the Consequences section of ADR 0026 in the worktree.
The bullet now reads "`just install`, which runs `kmctl plugin patch` by tag through `uvx`, fills the same cache." A grep for `apm install` in the ADR finds nothing.

Checked the claim against `starter/justfile.jinja`: the `install` and `install-frozen` recipes call `{{kmctl}} plugin patch`, where `kmctl := "uvx --from " + kmctl_src + " kmctl"` and `kmctl_src` is the git URL at `kmctl_ref`.
Re-ran `loopctl gate stamp` from the worktree.
It printed: "stamp green: 96647e295268a6a8d0b9d72c801c1ba9b1c9a75c2a3cc892fbe561ed3d543d81", which matches the stamp the briefing named.
f1 (resolved): the ADR sentence no longer credits `apm install` with running kmctl.
It names `just install`, which the starter justfile shows is correct.
